vectors.desc: tag = index into the value's own in-stream table, ARG-minimal
deriv: DESC VARIANT: E0, kind 1 inline D1, nominal name 'e' (61 65), ARG n=2, alts 'A' (61 41) and 'B' (61 42) with their type-refs (WF-22 :598-600, :611, :620, :633-636); ids DFS: e=0, 'e'=1, 'A'=2, INT-8 DESC=3, 'B'=4 (WF-22 :657-667)
the second alt's type-ref is REF d3 — structural hash-consing: the second occurrence of one descriptor in a stream is a REF (WF-22 :654-660)
value: token c1 = class C << 4 | inline tag 1 — an index into the table, minimal on the inline rung (WF-23 :717; WF-21 :563-568); payload INT 3 under the alt's type: zz(3)=6 -> 26 (WF-8 :328-331)

vectors.desc: name-sorted table case-sensitive ('B' < 'a'); STRUCT payload composition
deriv: table sorted by variant name under the WF-22 key — raw bytes, case-sensitive: 'B' (42) sorts before 'a' (61) although 'a' precedes 'B' in the binding's declaration; declaration order never leaks into the table (WF-21 :576-580; WF-22 :668-674)

alt 'a' carries an anonymous STRUCT payload {x: INT-8, y: INT-8} — the sum composes over the product kinds, never inside them (WF-21 :569-571); the field table sorts x < y and both type-refs REF d3, the already-registered INT-8 (WF-22 :654-660, :668-674)
value: c1 = tag 1 = 'a' (index into the sorted table), payload STRUCT b0 with field values in table order: x = zz(2) = 4 (24), y = zz(1) = 2 (22) (WF-19 :541-546; WF-23 :716)

vectors.desc: payloadless alternative carries the empty TUPLE(0)
deriv: the payloadless alt's type-ref is TUPLE arity 0 — e0 d2 00, the unit of positional payload composition (WF-21 :571-573; WF-22 :606, :611-612)
value: c0 = tag 0 inline-minimal, then the payload body = TUPLE token 50 with a zero-element body — no bytes follow the token (WF-21 :571-573; WF-23 :712, :717)

vectors.desc: Some(None): nesting resolves through the payload position; recursive table REF
deriv: Option is a library-level two-variant sum: table sorted 'None' (4E..) < 'Some' (53..); Some's type-ref is REF d0 — the descriptor's own id, registered before its children, so the recursive type closes through a REF (WF-21 :586-588; WF-24 :762-766; WF-22 :654-660)

value: c1 = tag 1 (Some); the payload is itself a variant of the same descriptor — c0 50 = tag 0 (None) with the empty TUPLE(0) body; Some(None) resolves naturally through the payload position, no extra machinery (WF-21 :586-588)

vectors.desc: positional TUPLE payload: alt P -> TUPLE(INT-8, INT-8), elements never reordered
deriv: alt 'P' carries a positional product: TUPLE arity 2, second element type-ref REF d4 (hash-consing, WF-22 :654-660) — the sum composes over positional products exactly as over named ones (WF-21 :569-571)
value: c0 + payload 50 24 22 — zz(2)=4, zz(1)=2 stay in declaration order; canonical name-sorted order governs named tables, not positional products (WF-20 :552-558)

table [b, a]: the second alt name 'a' (61 61) sorts before 'b' (62) — a table emitted in any other order than name-sorted is non-canonical, a decoder reject; the prefix halts at the out-of-order name (WF-21 :576-580)
canonical spelling spells the same table [a, b] with tag indexes renumbered accordingly — one legal byte sequence per value (VS-1/VS-3)

vectors.desc: non-minimal tag argument rejected: tag 0 on the u8 rung
deriv: value token c8 00: the tag rides the u8 rung with payload 00 — tag 0 fits the inline nibble (rung caps at 7); a tag argument wider than its minimal form is non-canonical and a decoder reject (WF-21 :563-568; WF-7 :299-311)
canonical spelling is c0 50 (V-75)

vectors.desc: empty variant table rejected: a sum with no alternatives
deriv: ARG n = 0: a sum with no alternatives cannot be instantiated — a VARIANT descriptor whose variant table is empty is ill-formed and a decoder rejects it; the prefix halts at the zero arity (WF-21 :583-586)

vectors.desc: by-name evolution: stream alt name absent from the decoding table
deriv: the stream is a legal encoding of alt 'Z' (tag 0, payload INT 3) — the would-be canonical bytes; the violation is contextual: the decode target's table for 'e' holds no 'Z', and the decoder matches alternatives by name, never by position (WF-21 :580-582; WF-6 :256-258)
reject fires for that value; the rest of the stream is unaffected — evolution is additive-by-name, and a missing name is a format error, not a default (WF-21 :582)

vectors.desc: evolution kind mismatch: alt present in both stream and target with incompatible kind
deriv: the stream encodes alt 'A' with an INT payload (zz(5)=10 -> 28 0A); the decoding descriptor declares 'A' with a STRING payload — a field present in both stream and target with an incompatible kind is a decoder reject, not a default-value skip (WF-6 :258-259)
the skip path stays loud: unknown shapes skip to defaults, incompatible kinds reject — the stream bytes themselves are canonical (would-be canonical bytes, the target refuses)
